baseline1-0bbeaed.method: Same-host independent Writer/Reader processes, RELIABLE KEEP_LAST16, 64 native slots, batches of8 with receiver acknowledgements; 32 warmup samples excluded from timing, every payload word validated. Throughput includes fill/validation/control/scheduling. Latency from monotonic timestamp immediately before write to take before integrity scan; nearest-rank quantiles. Shared VM with swap, no dedicated-host SLA or maximum sustainable-throughput claim.

aggregation: Median of the three per-run metrics; nearest-rank quantiles within each run. Per-role RSS maximum.
noise_rule: N=abs(B2-B1); T outside [min(B1,B2),max(B1,B2)] and both abs(T-Bi)>N, strictly and same direction.
historical_policy: 10/28 only is reference. The first interrupted attempt nine cases are not read or used.
limitations: Two baseline medians define observed drift, not a confidence interval or statistical significance.
Shared two-core VM, three short runs per cell, 256/256/128 samples; no causal isolation of the lock.
Bookend checks cannot rule out short-lived external work entirely inside each group.
